deviations: Under the scrim: the previous non-admin route is drawn as the Owner's SCR-010 workspace (e42kit.app_shell: E10-D02's chrome, the WorkspaceCanvas one neutral placeholder) in both frames. RA-1 (L223) names 'the previous non-admin route (D6), or SCR-010 on a deep link', gate.cancel_note says 'you return to your workspace' (§14 L601) and no source names another route; any other previous route sits under the scrim the same way, with its own content.
No CMP-087 band, rule, strip or PageHeader is drawn: under D6 (L119) the gate overlays the previous non-admin route, 'so no admin data renders before unlock'; the CMP-087 states are boards 01-07's.

The NavRail's Admin entry (Owner, E10-D02:64) is drawn unselected, as e42kit.app_shell draws SCR-010: the route under the scrim is the previous non-admin one (D6); no source says whether the rail marks /admin current while the gate is open.

Spec gap: CMP-201 PasswordField has a reveal toggle by default (showReveal = true, a <button aria-pressed> 'Show password', 15:2345-2347), but §5 L236 and §13 L582 give the gate four tab stops (Password → code → Cancel → Unlock admin), so the toggle is not drawn (showReveal = false); the spec owner confirms that or adds the toggle and its tab stop (and its label to §14).

CMP-204 OtpInput is drawn as one input well (D7 L120: 'one input'), with no per-digit cells (15:2374 describes cells behind one labelled input); its accessible name is its visible label 'Authenticator code' (D7: 'name = label'), where 15:2374 names it 'Six-digit authentication code'. Empty in RA-1: its digits would set in type.num.base (kit field(mono=True)).

Field widths (kit choice: no source sets CMP-201 or CMP-204 widths): both span the dialog's 432 px inner width; the focused Password well is 424 px inside its CMP-039 ring wrapper (e42kit adds space.inset.xs on each side), so the ring's outer edge is level with the Authenticator code well.

gate.cancel_note sits on its own line above the action row in type.ui.caption, color.text.secondary (8.14 on overlay, §15 L648) (kit choice: D02:705 and §14 L601 give the string, no source places it or sets its type); it is not in the dialog's description (§5 L237: aria-describedby = the body).

'Unlock admin' is the CMP-001 primary variant (§15 L639: 4.76) and Cancel the secondary (§15 L648: 10.17), right-aligned, Cancel first, as D02:265's wireframe orders them (kit choice: §5 L213 names CMP-001 and the order only); neither holds focus on open (focus starts on Password, L236).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.
CMP-043 'size' Default and Large are drawn 480 and 640 px wide (kit choice): §5 L211, §9 L415 and §12 L530 name the sizes, and no source gives their widths.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes). The chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers as on boards 01-10, though `15` names color.surface.raised for CMP-071 NavRail, CMP-072 TopBar and CMP-209 RightRail (15:699, :708, :2421) and color.surface.sunken for CMP-208 StatusBar (15:2411): binding them is a kit change for every board (routed to the kit owner, as board 06 records). Here all of it sits under the scrim.

Local helper kit_fixups(): the kit's 'RightRail (composition)' takes the build notes' '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' name 'CMP-209 RightRail (composition)' (15:2416), as board 06 does; the other kit boards keep the kit's name until e42kit renames it.

The kit's 'token: size.control.comfortable …' line (the validator's Tier-1 WARN on every 32 px control) is kept off the annotation column, so its footer ends inside the 1760 px root; it stays in the sheet notes and the .md, and the column's tokens line lists the token (as board 07 does).
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
